name: cache
description: Installs and enables local Memcached and Redis services, including Redis password authentication and logging configuration. It also removes selected Redis replication-related directives after installation.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application from Git with a Python virtual environment and Uvicorn systemd service. It installs and provisions local PostgreSQL with the FastAPI database and user.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx HTTPS virtual hosts and static content for the test, CI, and status sites, including per-site TLS certificates. It also applies host protections such as Fail2ban, UFW, sysctl settings, and SSH hardening.
